shifts.summary: The shift covered English preparation for SSC CGL 1st shift. Candidates were given practice on idioms, one‑word vocabulary, phrasal verbs, error detection, direct‑indirect conversion, passive voice, prepositions and antonyms. The other sections (reasoning, GA, quant) had no specific information. All figures are unofficial.

sections.name: English Comprehension
sections.notes: Focus on idioms, grammar transformations and vocabulary.

asked.q: One‑word for a person who sets fires (pyromania)
One‑word for speed of an object in one direction (velocity)
Phrasal verb: go back on (renege on a promise)
Phrasal verb: hand over (give to someone else)
Error detection: "Everyone of the films you suggested are not worth" – correct verb
Error detection: "Neither of them sent their papers..." – pronoun usage
Direct‑indirect: My father said to me, "You have done well"
Direct‑indirect: She said to Rita, "Help me, please"
Passive voice: Why did she break the garden wall?
Fill in the blank: He jumped ___ the horse

intro: The SSC CGL Tier 1 exam was conducted on 26 October 2026 across three shifts. A partial analysis for shift 1 is available, covering English preparation topics such as idioms, one‑word vocabulary, phrasal verbs, error detection, direct‑indirect conversion, passive voice, prepositions and antonyms. All figures are unofficial and SSC normalises scores across shifts, so the numbers are indicative only. Shifts 2 and 3 are still pending and no usable analysis has been published for them at this time.
